about: The prayer asks God to hear our prayers with mercy and guard the defenders of the faith under His protection. It invokes Peter Martyr’s intercession.

s01.translation: Lord, through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your martyr, mercifully hear the prayers we offer You, and guard the defenders of the faith under Your protection. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

alignments.gloss: through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your martyr
who lives and reigns with You

w001.explanation: The prayers are what the Lord is asked to hear. Latin places them before the offering clause and Peter’s intercession, with the request to hear them coming later.

w008.explanation: Peter here is Peter Martyr, not Peter the Apostle.

w036.explanation: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
